resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Association lists two Wallaceton entries (Loc 1 and Loc 2). The Forest Lookouts Virginia page shows one entry spelled WALLACETOWN. The story reports the two Association entries and does not assume the Forest Lookouts entry covers both.
The Forest Lookouts page spells the name WALLACETOWN; the Association list and the DHR use Wallaceton. The story uses the Association spelling.

notes_for_editor: Thin. The Association lists this entry and a second Wallaceton entry (Loc 2) with coordinates and gone status only. The Forest Lookouts page has one WALLACETOWN entry with no county shown, so it does not settle how many towers the name covers. The Loc 1 and Loc 2 labels are not explained in any source read. The DHR page describes a building named Wallaceton in Chesapeake; no source read ties either lookout to it, so the story warns against confusing them. Two WebSearch queries plus one Dismal Swamp search found no build, staffing or removal history. A Facebook post about a Dismal Swamp tower near Suffolk is a different tower and was not used. Brief correction: local_unit should be an independent city, not a county. Next check: Virginia Department of Forestry records and Chesapeake local history.
